text:
**Best pick: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo)**, if you want the slimmest bank that works well with an iPhone 17. It's 0.34 inches thick and weighs 4.3 oz (122 g). It charges wirelessly at up to 15W and lists iPhone 17 compatibility. A 9to5Mac reviewer who handled it says it's the closest thing to Apple's MagSafe battery in form factor, and that it runs cooler than competitors ([Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank), [9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/)). It lists at $54.99 and is [available here](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank).

**If you want faster wireless charging:** The Baseus PicoGo AM52 is a 10,000mAh Qi2.2 bank that charges an iPhone 16 or later at 25W, which includes the iPhone 17. It's thicker and heavier than the Anker. Dealectric's listing shows $59.99 list, or $53.99 with code AM52 at Baseus's US store. [Buy it here](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w). Dealectric earns a commission if you buy through that link, and the code was last checked on 2026-10-24, so confirm it at checkout.

**Comparison of slim options from the reviews:**

| Power bank | Capacity | Wireless to iPhone 17 | Thickness / weight | Price (per source) | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Anker Nano 5K | 5,000mAh | 15W | 0.34 in / 122 g | $54.99 | [Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank) |
| Baseus PicoGo Air AM71 | 5,000mAh | 7.5W | 0.27 in / 104 g | $52.99 at Amazon | [Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge) |
| INIU SnapGo Air | 10,000mAh | 25W (Qi2.2) | 4.1 x 2.8 x 0.5 in / 195 g | $42.99–$54.99 (varies) | [Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge) |
| Baseus PicoGo AM52 | 10,000mAh | 25W (Qi2.2) | Not stated | $59.99 ($53.99 with code) | [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w) |

**Notes:**
- The Baseus AM71 is the thinnest and lightest, but its wireless charging is only 7.5W. That's slow for topping up an iPhone 17.
- The 25W Qi2.2 speed applies to iPhone 16 and later on current iOS. The iPhone 17 qualifies, and the iPhone Air tops out at 20W.
- Apple's own iPhone Air MagSafe battery is $99 and charges at only 12W, so the third-party options above are faster ([9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/)).
- Prices vary across the sources and change often. I didn't find direct retailer buy links for the INIU or Baseus AM71 in these results, so check the review pages for current retailer links.
